name: Swiss Weather
author: Jerome Maeder
description: Swiss weather from MeteoSwiss: station measurements, forecasts with their 10-90 % uncertainty bands, and day/week/wind charts. Favourite towns searchable offline, warnings with optional notifications, in English, French or German. (Omaxian catalog port — QML unchanged.)

barWidget.description: MeteoSwiss measurements, forecast and warnings for your Swiss towns

schema.label: Language
schema.description: en, fr or de. Empty follows the system locale; the panel's own selector writes here.

schema.label: Swiss cross badge
schema.description: Marks the bar icon with a small Swiss flag, which also tells it apart from the built-in weather widget.

schema.label: Show temperature in the bar
schema.description: Adds the current temperature next to the weather symbol.

schema.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often to poll MeteoSwiss. Clamped to 5-180 minutes.

schema.label: Detect region on first run
schema.description: Makes one geolocation request the first time the plugin runs, to pick a starting town. Turn off to keep every request on MeteoSwiss hosts.
